knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson requires permission, minimum necessary images and original timestamps, and says never to edit images to conceal a defect or keep copies on personal devices.
Work that cannot be completed safely or is outside scope is stopped, recorded and escalated for direction. The worked example repositions the photo and uploads it only through the approved system.
The detailed method says to confirm permission, purpose and the minimum image needed before taking a photo.

practicalCriteria: Collects relevant evidence without exposing private information, accurately labels records and preserves originals.
Uses the authorised work order and site instructions
Recognises and escalates hazards or scope limitations
Records objective evidence and correction where needed
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 1: Confirm the permission and purpose before taking any photograph, and decide the minimum image needed.
Record of procedure step 2: Frame the shot to keep people, addresses, documents, valuables, security codes and personal possessions out of view unless they are explicitly necessary and authorised.
Record of procedure step 3: Use only the approved work system, and do not keep copies on personal devices or send images by private messaging.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 3 is not done: Use only the approved work system, and do not keep copies on personal devices or send images by private messaging.
Stop work if procedure step 4 is not done: Keep the original timestamps and descriptions, and never edit an image to conceal a defect.
Stop work if procedure step 6 is not done: Stop and seek direction when work is unsafe, outside your training or conflicts with a site instruction.
